text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important part of NLP is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in written words. Another useful application is translation, where computers automatically change text from one language into another. NLP is also used for sentiment analysis, which helps identify whether a piece of writing expresses a positive, negative, or neutral feeling. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way. Thanks to these technologies, we can now interact with computers more easily than ever before.
